title: Apply a function twice
description: This beta reduction substitutes g and then a to produce two nested applications of g.

steps.description: The expression applies the apply-twice function to g and then to a.
The first beta reduction substitutes g for f in the lambda body, producing a function whose body contains g twice.

steps.question: Which variable does the next beta reduction replace with a?
steps.answer: It replaces the bound variable x with a.

steps.description: The remaining lambda applies its body to a, so substitution targets x.
Both occurrences of x become a. The normal form is g(g a).
